trial.recipe:
import copy, json, sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()/'bench'))
import run as runner
suite = runner.load_suite()
suite['cells'] = [
 dict(id='schur-balanced-k2',model='ols',design='dense',effects=2,regressors=2),
 dict(id='schur-balanced-k8',model='ols',design='dense',effects=2,regressors=8),
 dict(id='schur-balanced-k16',model='ols',design='dense',effects=2,regressors=16),
 dict(id='schur-weighted-k8',model='ols',design='dense',effects=2,regressors=8,weights='analytic'),
 dict(id='schur-skewed-k8',model='ols',design='dense',effects=2,regressors=8),
 dict(id='schur-weak-akm-k8',model='ols',design='akm-weak',effects=2,regressors=8),
]
suite['defaults']['rows']=100000
suite['tiers']['m1']=dict(cells=[c['id'] for c in suite['cells']],threads=[1,2,4,8,16],timeout_seconds=300)
runner.load_suite=lambda:copy.deepcopy(suite)
original_generate=runner.generate
def generate(cell,seed,path):
    metadata=original_generate(cell,seed,path)
    if cell['id']=='schur-skewed-k8':
        data=pd.read_stata(path,convert_categoricals=False)
        old=data['g2'].to_numpy().copy()
        skew=old.copy()
        skew[:len(skew)//2]=1
        data['y'] += (0.15/2)*(np.sin(skew/7)-np.sin(old/7))
        data['g2']=skew
        data.to_stata(path,write_index=False,version=114,time_stamp=datetime(2000,1,1))
        metadata.update(sha256=runner.sha256(path),recipe='Seeded dense panel; first half of rows placed in one second-effect level, with outcome FE contribution adjusted.')
        path.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2)+'\n')
    return metadata
runner.generate=generate
runner.run(runner.arguments())
